edition: Magical Athlete, 2025 CMYK edition (designed by Takashi Ishida, updated by Richard Garfield, art by Angela Kirkwood). 36 racers. The rulebook was updated in Aug 2026 (BGG file CMYK_MA_Rulebook_081426.pdf). Ability text here is first-printing card text; rules come from the pre-update rulebook, with the known Aug 2026 changes marked.
note: Ability text is first-printing card text. Chinese names are unofficial fan translations. Art from an unofficial fan site; personal use only.

racers.name: Alchemist
abilities: When I roll a 1 or 2 for my main move, I can move 4 instead.

racers.name: Baba Yaga
abilities: Trip any racer that stops on my space, or when I stop on theirs.
racers.notes: If I share a space with the Duelist, we can duel, but the Duelist will still trip. The Hypnotist can cast their spell on me, but they still trip.

racers.name: Banana
abilities: I trip any racer that passes me.

racers.name: Blimp
abilities: When I start my turn before the second corner of the track, I get +3 to my main move. On or after that corner, I get -1.

racers.name: Centaur
abilities: When I pass a racer, they move -2.
racers.notes: A racer can't be hoofwhacked any farther back than the Start space.

racers.name: Cheerleader
abilities: Before my main move, I can make the racer(s) in last place move 2. If I do, I move 1.
racers.notes: If there is more than one racer in last place, you have to cheer for all of them. You only move +1 regardless of how many racers are in last. If you cheer yourself, those are two separate moves: move 2 then move 1.

racers.name: Coach
abilities: Everyone on my space gets +1 to their main move, including me.
racers.notes: Remember that I get my power's benefit too!

racers.name: Copy Cat
abilities: I have the power of the racer currently in the lead. If there's a tie, I pick.
racers.notes: Card reads 'Copy Cat'; rulebook spells it 'Copycat'. I persistently have the power of the lead racer, not just on my turn. If there's ever a contradiction between me and the racer I'm copying (like Huge Baby), their power takes priority. I never copy 'before my race' powers.

racers.name: Dicemonger
abilities: Anyone can reroll their main move once per turn. When another racer does it, I move 1.

racers.name: Duelist
abilities: Whenever a racer shares my space, I can shout DUEL! We roll our dice and whoever rolls highest moves 2. I win ties.
racers.notes: I can duel multiple times in a turn, including when it's not my turn. I just need to be sharing a space to immediately declare a duel. I can't interrupt actions in progress, like between a roll and a move.

racers.name: Egg
abilities: Before my race, draw 3 new racers from the deck and pick one. I have its powers.
racers.notes: You should still use my racer token! I still get any 'before race' powers.

racers.name: Flip Flop
abilities: I can skip rolling for my main move and swap spaces with another racer instead.
racers.notes: My flop flip is a warp: it doesn't count as a move and I don't roll. I never occupy the same space as a racer I switch places with. We flop flip simultaneously.

racers.name: Genius
abilities: I can predict what number I'll roll for my main move. If I'm right, I take another turn after this one.

racers.name: Gunk
abilities: Other racers get -1 to their main move.
racers.notes: My goop reduces the move amount, not the die roll number. So it doesn't make a 6 into a 5 and keep the Lackey from doing their job.

racers.name: Hare
abilities: I get +2 to my main move. When I start my turn alone in the lead, I skip my main move.

racers.name: Heckler
abilities: When a racer ends their turn within 1 space of where they started, I move 2.
racers.notes: My power works for racers recovering from tripping.

racers.name: Huge Baby
abilities: No one can ever be on my space, besides the Start. Whenever that would happen, put the racer on the space behind me instead.
racers.notes: When other racers are put behind me because of my power, that doesn't count as a move: it's like they just stopped on that space instead.

racers.name: Hypnotist
abilities: Before my main move, I can warp a racer to my space.

racers.name: Inchworm
abilities: When another racer rolls a 1 for their main move, they skip that move and I move 1.
racers.notes: If another racer rolls a 1 and the Skipper is also on the track with me, I wriggle 1 and then the Skipper takes their turn.

racers.name: Lackey
abilities: When another racer rolls a 6 for their main move, I move 2 before they move.

racers.name: Leaptoad
abilities: While moving, I skip spaces with other racers on them.

racers.name: Legs
abilities: I can skip rolling for my main move and move 5 instead.
racers.notes: My power counts as my main move, so can be gooped by Gunk or get the hustle bonus from Coach.

racers.name: Lovable Loser
abilities: Before my main move, I get 1 point chip if I'm alone in last place.

racers.name: Magician
abilities: I can reroll my main move up to two times.
racers.notes: I must use whatever my last roll is.

racers.name: Mastermind
abilities: At the start of my first turn, I predict which racer will win. If I'm right, the race ends immediately and I finish 2nd.
racers.notes: If I predict myself, I can win both 1st and 2nd.

racers.name: M.O.U.T.H.
abilities: When I stop on a space with exactly one other racer, they're eliminated from the race.
racers.notes: If I chomp so many racers that no one crosses the finish line second, no one gets those points and you can discard that race's silver rosette.

racers.name: Party Animal
abilities: Before my main move, all racers move 1 space towards me. Each other racer on my space gives me +1 to my main move.
racers.notes: If Huge Baby parties onto my space, everyone there gets put 1 space back.

racers.name: Rocket Scientist
abilities: When I roll for my main move, I can move double that number. If I do, I trip.
racers.notes: Rulebook version reads '...If I do, I trip after moving.'

racers.name: Romantic
abilities: When anyone stops on a space with exactly one other racer, I move 2.
racers.notes: Pre-Aug-2026 note: if two racers move together, like with the Suckerfish, my power triggers twice. Aug 2026 update: racers arriving simultaneously no longer trigger 'stopping on a space' powers, so this combo no longer works.

racers.name: Scoocher
abilities: When another racer's power happens, I move 1.
racers.notes: With Gunk, scooch 1 for every -1 that affects a racer's main move. With Dicemonger, move for each reroll. With Leaptoad, move for each space skipped (2 consecutive occupied spaces = move 1 twice). Scooch 1 on each Magician reroll, even if it's not used.

racers.name: Sisyphus
abilities: Before my race, I take 4 point chips. When I roll a 6 for my main move, instead of moving, I warp to the Start and lose 1 point chip.
racers.notes: I still get my main move after warping. If I roll more than 4 sixes, I continue to lose points, assuming I have any.

racers.name: Skipper
abilities: When anyone rolls a 1 for their main move, I go next in turn order.
racers.notes: After I go, turn order continues to my left. (Unless I roll a 1 and go again!)

racers.name: Stickler
abilities: Other racers can only cross the finish line by moving the exact amount they need. If they overshoot, they don't move.
racers.notes: This includes any movement from main moves, powers, etc. E.g. if the Duelist wins a duel on the final space before the finish line, they don't cross.

racers.name: Suckerfish
abilities: When a racer on my space moves, I can move to their new space.
racers.notes: I can cross the finish line using my power. If I start moving with a racer, I can't stop until they finish that move.

racers.name: Third Wheel
abilities: Before my main move, I can warp to any space with exactly 2 racers on it.
racers.notes: I still get my main move after warping.

racers.name: Twin
abilities: Before my race, I can pick a racer who won a previous race and race with their powers.
racers.notes: You should still use my racer token! I still get any 'before race' powers.
